tagline: MADE IN INDONESIA. BUILT FOR THE WORLD.

highlights.title: 5 production facilities
highlights.body: TMMIN operates world-class production facilities in Sunter and Karawang for vehicles, engines, components and production tools.

highlights.title: 99 export destinations
highlights.body: Toyota Indonesia exports CBU, CKD, engines, components and production tools across multiple global regions.

highlights.title: Toyota Production System
highlights.body: Manufacturing is structured around Jidoka, Just-in-Time and continuous efficiency across the production process.

highlights.title: 50+ years in Indonesia
highlights.body: TMMIN has grown as a major manufacturing and export base in the Asia-Pacific automotive ecosystem.
